display.purpose: Hero and section-opening headlines. Fraunces 600, ceiling ~4rem.

body.purpose: All running copy. DM Mono 400, cap measure at ~70ch.

label.purpose: Metadata, tags, button and nav text. DM Mono 500, uppercase, tracking 0.15em.

shadows.name: diffused
shadows.purpose: Resting tactility for surface cards and panels.

shadows.name: deep
shadows.purpose: Hover/active elevation; material presses toward the reader.

motion.name: ease-smooth
motion.purpose: Default easing (ease-out-expo) for all state transitions and reveals.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Filled ink pill for the primary call to action; shifts to clay on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: var(--color-ink, #36322f); color: var(--color-base, #fdfcf8); font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace; font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.75rem; letter-spacing: 0.15em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 0.75rem 1.75rem; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background 300ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform 300ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-accent, #cc8b65); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent, #cc8b65); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Outlined pill that inverts to ink fill on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: var(--color-base, #fdfcf8); color: var(--color-ink, #36322f); font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace; font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.75rem; letter-spacing: 0.15em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 0.75rem 1.75rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-ink, #36322f); border-radius: 9999px; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background 300ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), color 300ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--color-ink, #36322f); color: var(--color-base, #fdfcf8); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent, #cc8b65); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Text-only action; ink shifts to clay on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace; font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.75rem; letter-spacing: 0.15em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--color-ink, #36322f); background: none; border: none; padding: 0.5rem 0; cursor: pointer; text-decoration: none; transition: color 300ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { color: var(--color-accent, #cc8b65); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent, #cc8b65); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.html:
SVELTEKIT · FASTAPI

components.css: .ds-card { display: block; background: var(--color-base, #fdfcf8); border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-ink, #36322f) 8%, transparent); border-radius: 1.25rem; padding: 2rem; transition: all 300ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); box-shadow: inset 0px 2px 8px -2px rgba(54,50,47,0.08), 0px 8px 24px -6px rgba(54,50,47,0.04); } .ds-card:hover { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-accent, #cc8b65) 40%, transparent); box-shadow: inset 0px 4px 16px -4px rgba(54,50,47,0.12), 0px 12px 32px -8px rgba(54,50,47,0.08); transform: translateY(-4px); } .ds-card-tag { font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.15em; color: var(--color-tension, #7d9c8b); } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Fraunces', serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 1.25rem; line-height: 1.3; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: var(--color-ink, #36322f); margin: 0.5rem 0; } .ds-card-body { font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.6; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-ink, #36322f) 70%, transparent); margin: 0; }

narrative.overview: This is a portfolio where the design is itself the argument. Everything on the surface is tactile and exact at once — sun-bleached paper, raw ceramic, baked clay — the materials of something made by hand, but assembled with an engineer's precision. Warmth carries the personality; precision carries the credibility. The two are never traded against each other. Serif headlines (Fraunces) speak with confidence; a monospace body (DM Mono) speaks with technical precision. It rejects both the stock engineer-portfolio (dark mode, neon accent, hero-metric template) and the sterile navy corporate gloss — enterprise-credible without being sterile, distinctive without being gimmicky.
keyCharacteristics: Warm ceramic-and-paper palette — never dark mode, never neon.
Fraunces serif display against a DM Mono body: confident + technical in one pairing.
Tactile depth via soft inset+drop shadows, not hard drop shadows or flat corporate surfaces.
Full, quiet borders and generous radii; no colored side-stripes, no hard edges.
Motion is choreographed and purposeful (GSAP + Lenis), with full reduced-motion equivalents.

rules.name: The Warm-Neutral Rule
rules.body: The body is always paper (#fdfcf8) or ceramic (#f2f0e9). Dark mode is forbidden; a dark surface is a deliberate, local inversion, never the page.

rules.name: The One-Clay Rule
rules.body: Baked Clay stays under ~10% of any screen. Text hierarchy comes from weight, size, and the ink ramp (100/70/50% opacity), not from spraying the accent everywhere.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Serif for what asserts (headlines, names), mono for what informs (body, data, labels). Never blur the two — no serif body, no mono headlines.

rules.name: The Mono-Measure Rule
rules.body: Monospace body is wider per character; never run it past ~70ch or it becomes a wall.

rules.name: The Warm-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows are always keyed to ink (#36322f) at low opacity, never black. A cold gray shadow breaks the ceramic warmth instantly.

rules.name: The Depth-On-Intent Rule
rules.body: Surfaces rest at Diffused and rise to Deep only on hover/focus. Depth signals interactivity; a static deep shadow is noise.

dos: Do keep the body on Sun-bleached Paper (#fdfcf8) or Raw Ceramic (#f2f0e9). Warmth lives in the surface.
Do pair Fraunces headlines with DM Mono body — serif asserts, mono informs.
Do hold Baked Clay under ~10% of any screen; derive hierarchy from the ink opacity ramp (100/70/50%).
Do key every shadow to ink at low opacity, resting at Diffused and rising to Deep on interaction.
Do give featured projects bespoke layouts (editorial/data/immersive/compact) rather than one repeated card.
Do ship a full prefers-reduced-motion equivalent for every GSAP/scroll animation; reveals must enhance already-visible content, never gate it (WCAG 2.1 AA).
Do verify body text hits ≥4.5:1 — ink on paper passes; .text-muted (ink at 50%) is metadata-only, never body.
donts: Don't ship a generic template portfolio: no dark mode + neon accent, no hero-metric card template, no identical icon-heading-text project grid.
Don't drift corporate/SaaS sterile: no navy-and-blue, no flat personality-free enterprise gloss.
Don't go overdesigned/gimmicky: no motion or effects that fight legibility, no cleverness over clarity.
Don't let it read as a resume-as-webpage: no flat CV text dump without hierarchy or narrative.
Don't use glassmorphism decoratively — it's reserved for the nav backdrop and rare purposeful overlays only.
Don't use cursor: none (or any hidden-cursor trick) as a click-blocking mechanism.
Don't use colored side-stripe borders (border-left/right >1px) or gradient text — both banned.
Don't run DM Mono body past ~70ch, or use pure black anywhere.
